en: A black‑and‑white view of a large, rectangular civic building facing a tree‑lined square. The façade is plain with regularly spaced windows and a central arched entrance. On the steep slate roof stands a prominent clock tower with a cupola and ornamental finials; additional small turrets rise at the roof corners. In the foreground are young trees, a cobbled plaza, and several horse‑drawn carriages. Hills with scattered buildings rise in the background, suggesting a town in a river valley or at the edge of mountains.
